answer: The delta counter is kept in yarrow and raven shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 34 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 34 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2514 identities would post 4124 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
